scope: Read-only reference snapshot for planning. No implementation, dependency closure, asset reuse, product test, or complete license clearance is represented.

snapshotPolicy.sha256: SHA256 of exact local file bytes at collection time
snapshotPolicy.untrackedFiles: Working-tree teaching and analysis documents are not reconstructable from the source baseline commit; baselineCommit and baselineSha256 are null.
snapshotPolicy.trackedFiles: workingTreeState and gitStatus report Git state. matchesBaseline compares exact file bytes; checkout CRLF conversion can differ while Git remains clean. baselineByteRelation distinguishes that case. No field establishes runtime correctness.
snapshotPolicy.coverage: Files linked from REFERENCES.md and the 24 course lesson/answer/lab/review records. Not a transitive dependency inventory.
snapshotPolicy.implementation: Files remain in the read-only reference repository; no third-party source or assets copied.
snapshotPolicy.learnerMastery: Not inferred from sourceMaterialStatus or referenced experiment results.

groups.title: 对话图与模型适配
groups.proposedBoundary: 重写图编排，选择性提取模型与工具适配。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: 会话、流式输出与取消
groups.proposedBoundary: 复用状态约束，重写与图之间的会话协调层。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: 长期记忆写入、召回与纠错
groups.proposedBoundary: 提取已有实现，组成唯一 Memory Service。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: 前端、角色资料与角色渲染
groups.proposedBoundary: 提取展示组件，重接事件和资源服务。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: 语音输入、身份与输出
groups.proposedBoundary: 提取一种 ASR 和一种 TTS 适配，独立管理媒体生命周期。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: 视觉输入与主动陪伴
groups.proposedBoundary: 先手动视觉输入，主动行为作为图的另一种事件入口。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: Agent、工具、插件与 MCP
groups.proposedBoundary: 先只读搜索与正文工具，再评估兼容插件宿主；当前不做键鼠/电脑控制。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: 互动、娱乐、生活工具与跨渠道
groups.proposedBoundary: 公开资料搜索为 M1 首版必需；其他娱乐、提醒和渠道能力仍是选择性扩展。
groups.phaseScopeNote: M1 requires public search and page reading; M5 reuses them for image questions. Other entertainment and channel modules are optional. Keyboard/mouse and computer control are excluded from current scope.

groups.title: 数据、配置、凭据与同步
groups.proposedBoundary: 借鉴隔离规则，重写本工程启动配置。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.

groups.title: Windows 启动、桌面宿主与打包
groups.proposedBoundary: 提取运行保障，建立本工程构建流程；外部 Electron 待核实。
groups.phaseScopeNote: Selected feature slices only; complete courses and all listed modules are not mandatory for a phase.
